args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am writing to request a private dining table for 12 people next Friday. I came across your restaurant's private dining options mentioned in reviews and would like to inquire about availability and menu options.

Could you please provide information about:
- Available time slots next Friday
- Menu options for groups of 12
- Pricing details
- Any special requirements or notes

I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
